entries.title: Hosea 10:1
segments: ¶Israel is an unpruned vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the abundance of his fruit he hath multiplied altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly statues.

entries.title: Hosea 10:2
segments: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found guilty: he will break down their altars, he will destroy their statues.

entries.title: Hosea 10:3
segments: For now they will say, We have no king, for we feared not Jehovah; and a king, what can he do for us?

entries.title: Hosea 10:4
segments: They speak [mere] words, swearing falsely in making a covenant; therefore shall judgment spring up as hemlock in the furrows of the fields.

entries.title: Hosea 10:5
segments: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calf of Beth-aven; for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the idolatrous priests thereof shall tremble for it, for its glory, because it is departed from it.

entries.title: Hosea 10:6
segments: Yea, it shall be carried unto Assyria [as] a present for king Jareb: Ephraim shall be seized with shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

entries.title: Hosea 10:7
segments: As for Samaria her king is cut off as chips upon the face of the waters.

entries.title: Hosea 10:8
segments: And the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up upon their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us! and to the hills, Fall on us!

entries.title: Hosea 10:9
segments: ¶From the days of Gibeah hast thou sinned, O Israel: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.

entries.title: Hosea 10:10
segments: At my pleasure will I chastise them; and the peoples shall be assembled against them, when they are bound for their two iniquities.

entries.title: Hosea 10:11
segments: And Ephraim is a trained heifer, that loveth to tread out [the corn]; I have passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to draw; Judah shall plough, Jacob shall break his clods.

entries.title: Hosea 10:12
segments: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek Jehovah, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

entries.title: Hosea 10:13
segments: Ye have ploughed wickedness, reaped iniquity, eaten the fruit of lies; for thou didst confide in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.

entries.title: Hosea 10:14
segments: And a tumult shall arise among thy peoples, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces with the children.

entries.title: Hosea 10:15
segments: So shall Bethel do unto you because of the wickedness of your wickedness: at day-break shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
